description: Image Editor Web Component - drop-in that wraps an with resize handles, edit/alt buttons, and canvas-based pixel resize

userStories.title: Scaffold component to accept child
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the component to capture a child element and render a wrapper structure so that overlay chrome can be layered on top.
acceptanceCriteria: Rename class from Example to ImageEditor throughout src/index.ts
On connectedCallback, capture the first child element before render
If no child is found, render nothing and log a warning via @substrate-system/debug
Render wraps the captured in a container div with class 'image-editor-container'
The child displays at its natural or attributed size inside the container
Container has position:relative so overlay elements can be absolutely positioned
Update example/index.html and example/index.ts to include a child element
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: CSS custom properties for theming
userStories.description: As a developer, I want all visual values to use --image-editor-* CSS custom properties so I can theme the component to fit my design system.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/_vars.css with --image-editor-* custom properties for: handle-size, handle-bg, handle-border, outline-color, outline-width, outline-style, button-size, overlay-padding
Import _vars.css in src/index.css
All color, size, and spacing values in index.css reference the custom properties
Variables have sensible defaults (handle-size: 10px, outline: dashed 2px, etc.)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Render dashed outline and corner handles
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the image to display with a dashed border outline and four corner resize handles so the user sees visual affordances for resizing.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashed border outline renders around the image boundary (always visible, not hover-dependent)
Outline uses CSS variables from _vars.css for width, color, and style
Four corner handle elements render at top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right
Handles are absolutely positioned at each corner of the container
Handles use correct cursor values: nwse-resize for top-left and bottom-right, nesw-resize for top-right and bottom-left
Handle styling: small squares (size from --image-editor-handle-size) with solid fill and border
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Pointer-driven drag resize with aspect ratio lock
userStories.description: As a user, I want to drag a corner handle to resize the image proportionally so that the aspect ratio is preserved during resize.
acceptanceCriteria: Dragging any corner handle scales the image proportionally (aspect ratio locked)
Uses pointerdown/pointermove/pointerup events (not mouse events) for touch compatibility
Uses setPointerCapture so drag continues even if cursor leaves the handle
During drag, image dimensions update in real time via inline CSS (style.width, style.height)
Component emits image-editor:resize-start on pointerdown
Pointer movement does not emit image-editor:resize
A dragged pointerup emits one image-editor:resize event
Aspect ratio is computed from the image's initial dimensions and preserved during drag
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Canvas blob production on resize end
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the component to produce a pixel-resized Blob when a drag ends so I can upload or process the resized image.
acceptanceCriteria: On pointerup (drag end), draw the original image source to an offscreen canvas at the new dimensions
Use createImageBitmap where available for better quality, fall back to drawing from the element
Produce a Blob via canvas.toBlob()
Component emits image-editor:resize-end with { blob, width, height } detail
The blob dimensions match the visual CSS dimensions
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Edit button with pencil icon
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a pencil icon button in the overlay so I can listen for an event and open my own editing UI.
acceptanceCriteria: A pencil icon button renders in the overlay area at the top of the image
Overlay layout: flex, space-between, with controls on the right (matching image-input pattern)
Pencil icon uses the same SVG path as image-input's edit button
Clicking the button emits cancelable image-editor:edit event with { img } detail (reference to child )
No built-in dialog opens -- the consumer handles the event
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: ALT badge button with MutationObserver
userStories.description: As a developer, I want an ALT badge button that reflects the image's alt attribute so I can listen for an event and open my own alt-text UI.
acceptanceCriteria: An ALT text badge button renders in the overlay area (left side, matching image-input pattern)
Badge shows '+ALT' when the child has no alt attribute or empty alt
Badge shows 'ALT' when the child has a non-empty alt attribute
Badge state updates via a MutationObserver watching the child 's alt attribute
Clicking the badge emits cancelable image-editor:alt event with { alt, img } detail
No built-in dialog opens -- the consumer handles the event
MutationObserver is disconnected in disconnectedCallback
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Free-form resize attribute
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to opt into unconstrained resizing by adding a free-form attribute so width and height can change independently.
acceptanceCriteria: When free-form attribute is present, dragging a handle allows independent width/height changes
Corner handles resize both axes freely (no aspect ratio lock)
The free-form attribute can be toggled at runtime and takes effect on the next drag
Reflected as a boolean property on the element
When free-form is removed, resize reverts to aspect-ratio-constrained behavior
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Minimum size constraint
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to set minimum dimensions so the image cannot be resized too small.
acceptanceCriteria: min-width and min-height attributes set minimum pixel dimensions
Defaults to 50x50 if attributes are not specified
Dragging past the minimum snaps to the minimum size
min-width and min-height are reflected as numeric properties on the element
Minimum constraint applies in both constrained and free-form resize modes
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Keyboard-driven resize
userStories.description: As a keyboard user, I want to resize the image using arrow keys when a handle is focused so I do not need a pointer device.
acceptanceCriteria: Corner handles are focusable (tabindex='0')
Arrow keys resize the image when a handle is focused (default step: 10px)
Shift+Arrow resizes in larger steps (50px)
Escape cancels an in-progress keyboard resize sequence
Each handle has an appropriate ARIA label (e.g. 'Resize from top-right corner')
Keyboard resize respects aspect-ratio constraint (unless free-form is set)
Keyboard resize respects minimum size constraint
Keyboard resize produces a canvas blob and emits resize-end, same as pointer resize
Typecheck passes
